usage: fnit applywarp [-h] -i INPUT -r REFERENCE [-w WARP] -o OUTPUT
                      [--premat PREMAT] [--postmat POSTMAT] [--abs | --rel]
                      [--interp {trilinear,nearest,nn}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -i INPUT, --in INPUT  input image to resample
  -r REFERENCE, --ref REFERENCE
                        reference image defining the output grid
  -w WARP, --warp WARP  FSL dense displacement field or FNIRT cubic
                        coefficient file
  -o OUTPUT, --out OUTPUT
  --premat PREMAT       input-to-warp-source FLIRT matrix
  --postmat POSTMAT     warp-reference-to-output FLIRT matrix
  --abs                 treat an untyped dense field as absolute coordinates
  --rel                 treat an untyped dense field as relative displacements
  --interp {trilinear,nearest,nn}
  --datatype {char,short,int,float,double}
  --device DEVICE
  --frame-chunk-size FRAME_CHUNK_SIZE
                        positive frame-buffer limit; CUDA auto policy if
                        omitted
  --overwrite

usage: fnit-flirt [-h] -in INPUT -ref REFERENCE [-out OUTPUT] [-omat OMAT]
                  [-init INIT] [-applyxfm] [-usesqform] [-inweight INWEIGHT]
                  [-refweight REFWEIGHT] [-dof {6,12}]
                  [-cost {corratio,normmi}] [--device DEVICE]
                  [--execution {auto,reference,batched}]
                  [--candidate-batch-size CANDIDATE_BATCH_SIZE]
                  [--memory-budget-gb MEMORY_BUDGET_GB] [--overwrite]

Run the source-derived PyTorch implementation of FLIRT's supported 12-DOF
correlation-ratio or 6-DOF normalized-mutual-information registration path, or
apply a known transform with -applyxfm. Other profiles are rejected.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -in INPUT, --in INPUT
                        input/moving 3D image
  -ref REFERENCE, --ref REFERENCE
                        reference/fixed image defining the output grid
  -out OUTPUT, --out OUTPUT
                        warped input on the reference grid
  -omat OMAT, --omat OMAT
                        input-to-reference 4x4 matrix in FSL scaled-mm
                        coordinates
  -init INIT, --init INIT
                        initial registration matrix, or the matrix applied by
                        -applyxfm
  -applyxfm             resample without estimating a new registration
  -usesqform            with -applyxfm, align input and reference qform/sform
                        world coordinates
  -inweight INWEIGHT, --inweight INWEIGHT
                        input-space voxelwise registration weight
  -refweight REFWEIGHT, --refweight REFWEIGHT
                        reference-space voxelwise registration weight
  -dof {6,12}           degrees of freedom; choose 6 with -cost normmi
  -cost {corratio,normmi}
                        cost function; choose normmi with -dof 6
  --device DEVICE       PyTorch device, for example cpu, cuda, or cuda:1;
                        default: CUDA when available
  --execution {auto,reference,batched}
                        candidate execution; auto batches CUDA and preserves
                        scalar CPU execution
  --candidate-batch-size CANDIDATE_BATCH_SIZE
                        maximum independent affine candidates per GPU chunk
  --memory-budget-gb MEMORY_BUDGET_GB
                        GPU memory budget; chunks also adapt to available
                        memory
  --overwrite           replace existing output files; outputs are otherwise
                        protected

usage: python -m fnit.fnirt [-h] --in INPUT --ref REF [--aff AFF]
                            [--cout COUT] [--iout IOUT] [--jout JOUT]
                            [--refmask REFMASK] [--config CONFIG]
                            [--subsamp SUBSAMP] [--miter MITER]
                            [--infwhm INFWHM] [--reffwhm REFFWHM]
                            [--lambda LAMBDA_VALUES] [--estint ESTINT]
                            [--applyrefmask APPLYREFMASK] [--warpres WARPRES]
                            [--biasres BIASRES] [--jacrange JACRANGE]
                            [--intmod {global_linear,global_non_linear_with_bias}]
                            [--intorder INTORDER] [--biaslambda BIASLAMBDA]
                            [--ssqlambda SSQLAMBDA] [--imprefm IMPREFM]
                            [--impinm IMPINM] [--minmet MINMET]
                            [--device DEVICE]
                            [--execution {reference,optimized}] [--overwrite]

Run PyTorch FNIRT with the FSL no-config defaults or the GM, T1, and UKB TBSS
presets. Only implemented FSL options can be overridden.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --in INPUT            input/moving 3D NIfTI
  --ref REF             reference/fixed 3D NIfTI
  --aff AFF             input-to-reference FLIRT matrix in FSL scaled-mm
                        coordinates; default: identity
  --cout COUT           output cubic coefficient NIfTI (intent 2007); default:
                        <input>_warpcoef with FSLOUTPUTTYPE extension
  --iout IOUT           output warped input on the reference grid
  --jout JOUT           output nonlinear-only Jacobian determinant
  --refmask REFMASK     reference-grid binary mask; required by GM and T1
                        presets
  --config CONFIG       default, gm, t1, tbss, or unmodified FSL GM/T1 config
                        (default: default)
  --subsamp SUBSAMP
  --miter MITER
  --infwhm INFWHM
  --reffwhm REFFWHM
  --lambda LAMBDA_VALUES
  --estint ESTINT
  --applyrefmask APPLYREFMASK
  --warpres WARPRES
  --biasres BIASRES
  --jacrange JACRANGE
  --intmod {global_linear,global_non_linear_with_bias}
  --intorder INTORDER
  --biaslambda BIASLAMBDA
  --ssqlambda SSQLAMBDA
  --imprefm IMPREFM
  --impinm IMPINM
  --minmet MINMET
  --device DEVICE       PyTorch device, for example cpu, cuda, or cuda:1;
                        default: CUDA when available
  --execution {reference,optimized}
                        dense reference or coefficient-space/fused GPU
                        execution; same schedule and precision
  --overwrite           replace existing output files; outputs are otherwise
                        protected

usage: fnit mcflirt [-h] -in INPUT -out OUTPUT [-reffile REFERENCE] [-mats]
                    [-plots] [-rmsrel] [-rmsabs] [-stages {1,2,3}]
                    [-spline_final | -trilinear_final] [--device DEVICE]
                    [--overwrite]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -in INPUT, --in INPUT
                        原始四维 BOLD NIfTI
  -out OUTPUT, --out OUTPUT
                        校正图输出路径或前缀
  -reffile REFERENCE    同网格的三维参考图；默认中间帧
  -mats                 输出每帧 input→reference 的 MAT_####
  -plots                输出六列弧度/mm 的 .par
  -rmsrel               输出相邻帧80mm球体RMS位移
  -rmsabs               输出各帧相对identity的80mm球体RMS位移
  -stages {1,2,3}       8/4/4 mm 阶段数
  -spline_final         最终使用三阶 B-spline
  -trilinear_final      最终使用三线性（原 MCFLIRT 默认）
  --device DEVICE       cpu、cuda 或 cuda:1
  --overwrite           覆盖已有输出

usage: fnit-mmorf [-h] --mov-scalar MOV_SCALAR --ref-scalar REF_SCALAR
                  --mov-tensor MOV_TENSOR --ref-tensor REF_TENSOR
                  [--aff-mov-scalar AFF_MOV_SCALAR]
                  [--aff-ref-scalar AFF_REF_SCALAR]
                  [--aff-mov-tensor AFF_MOV_TENSOR]
                  [--aff-ref-tensor AFF_REF_TENSOR]
                  [--scalar-weight SCALAR_WEIGHT] [--no-auto-linear] -o
                  OUTPUT_DIR [--device DEVICE] [--overwrite]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mov-scalar MOV_SCALAR
                        moving scalar; repeat in pair order
  --ref-scalar REF_SCALAR
                        reference scalar; repeat in pair order
  --mov-tensor MOV_TENSOR
                        moving FSL six-frame tensor
  --ref-tensor REF_TENSOR
                        reference FSL six-frame tensor
  --aff-mov-scalar AFF_MOV_SCALAR
                        moving scalar to common FLIRT matrix; repeat per pair,
                        use AUTO for missing
  --aff-ref-scalar AFF_REF_SCALAR
                        reference scalar to common FLIRT matrix; repeat per
                        pair, use AUTO for missing
  --aff-mov-tensor AFF_MOV_TENSOR
                        moving tensor to common FLIRT matrix
  --aff-ref-tensor AFF_REF_TENSOR
                        reference tensor to common FLIRT matrix
  --scalar-weight SCALAR_WEIGHT
                        scalar pair weight; repeat per pair
  --no-auto-linear      use identity for unspecified linear matrices
  -o OUTPUT_DIR, --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --device DEVICE
  --overwrite
